ended_at: about 18 hours later (MASA: 'For a period of 18 hours, we were not processing wastewater as normal')
location_text: Meadville Area Sewer Authority main pump station, Clark Road, Meadville (Crawford County)
units: gallons ('nearly 10 million gallons', MASA executive director)
authority: Meadville Area Sewer Authority; PA DEP and PA Fish and Boat Commission involved

raw_record.erienewsnow: Apr 20, 2026: rain flooded the station, all eight pumps shut down; 'nearly 10 million gallons of untreated sewage into French Creek'; city: DEP on site, water quality 'seems to be fine'

coverage_note: MASA is not a CSO permittee and no public notice from MASA or DEP was found; the event is known only through local news. Typical of PA SSOs: the legal notice goes to DEP (4-hour oral), not the public.
notes: No advisory text was found; do not invent one. Volume is the authority's own estimate.
